claim: The sample demo uses a separate workspace and never changes real work.
sandbox: Seed a real workspace, enter /demo, change and reset the sample, then prove the real workspace is unchanged.

claim: Source files and working data stay in this browser, and the demo flow makes only same-origin requests.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow with request interception; assert every request stays on the product origin.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context loads /demo, gains service-worker control, goes offline, and reloads the sample.

claim: Core handoff exports are free and contain the stated plan, cleaned data, report, and issue evidence.
where: Landing facts, README, handoff export cards
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow reaches handoff, downloads every artifact, and parses the JSON, CSV, Markdown report, and issue evidence.

claim: Opens XLSX files in the browser.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow uploads a shipped one-sheet XLSX fixture and verifies its worksheet and profile.

claim: An exported contract can be applied to a compatible source file.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow changes a mapping, exports the contract, replaces the source with compatible headers, imports the JSON, and verifies the mapping is restored.

claim: The product creates handoff files and does not import data into another system.
sandbox: Complete the sample handoff, export cleaned data, verify the downloaded rows, and assert the final action makes no network request.
